steps.eval: (async () => { const h = { 'content-type': 'application/json' }; const key = ['renderers', 'page', 'theme']; const c = await (await fetch('/config')).json(); const was = c.renderers?.page?.theme; const r = was === undefined ? await fetch('/config/add', { method: 'POST', headers: h, body: JSON.stringify({ key, value: 'themes/aqua' }) }) : await fetch('/config/set', { method: 'POST', headers: h, body: JSON.stringify({ key, value: 'themes/aqua', was }) }); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(await r.text()) })()
